sources.entry: Xournal++ - Take handwritten notes with ease

summary.one_liner: Xournal++ is a C++ handwritten note-taking application for pen-enabled devices, with PDF annotation, many drawing tools, and LaTeX and Lua plugin support.
summary.what_it_does: Xournal++ is a note-taking app written in C++ that supports pressure-sensitive styluses and digital pen tablets. It offers paper backgrounds for notes, scratch paper, or whiteboarding, and lets you annotate on top of PDFs, select and highlight text from the background PDF, and follow its links. Drawing tools include pen, highlighter, shape tools (line, arrow, circle, rectangle, spline), a set-square and compass, and a text tool, with grid snapping and input stabilization. Notes can be exported to SVG, PNG and PDF from the GUI or command line, and it supports LaTeX (with a LaTeX installation), audio recording alongside notes, and Lua plugins. The README also describes a .xopp file format (gzipped XML) that is compatible with the older Xournal .xoj format.
use_cases: Handwritten note-taking on a tablet or with a stylus
Marking up and highlighting PDF text
Creating whiteboard or scratch paper sketches
Exporting handwritten notes to PDF or SVG
how_to_run: Building instructions are in the project's Building section (Linux, macOS, Windows)
notable: Annotate PDFs and select, highlight, or strike through text from the background PDF
Supports .xoj files from the original Xournal and can export back to .xoj
Wide availability through Debian, Ubuntu PPA, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch, Flatpak, winget and Scoop
Customizable toolbars and mapping of tools to stylus or mouse buttons
Multi-language support with translations via Crowdin
caveats: The macOS app is not signed, so it needs terminal commands (xattr and codesign) before it runs
The mobile/web app (Flutter) development has stalled and the web app is no longer available
LaTeX support requires a separate LaTeX installation
